steps: write objects.js (Chunk, Resend, Analysis, Source, Session)
add static icon + inspect() support check on all five
full-bleed 2D layout: page.js classes:full + columns CSS, mobile tab fallback kept

decision.question: Does Session own cleaned_so_far/last_chunk_at/clean_queue too, since they're in reset()'s block?
options: move all of reset()'s fields into Session
keep the pipeline's own bookkeeping (cleaned_so_far, last_chunk_at, clean_queue) on Playground, only move the reader-facing state (chunks, resends, source, analysis, partial) into Session
decision.chose: the second — Session is what a reader inspects; cleaned_so_far/last_chunk_at/clean_queue are plumbing for the NEXT chunk that nobody asked to see, and putting them in the inspector would just add noise to every Structure panel render
decision.why: requirements.md deliverable 1 names exactly chunks/resends/source/analysis/partial as what Session owns

decision.question: Where does the Source (mic/level) column go in the full-bleed layout?
options: a narrow first grid column, literally beside Raw/Clean
a full-width header strip above the grid, since its real content (a device picker + a meter bar) is a horizontal control row, not vertical card content
decision.why: layout skill: content scale follows the box — squeezing a horizontal control row into a narrow vertical column fights its natural shape; the owner's own words said 'columns (or a table)', not a hard requirement for Source specifically to be a vertical column, and this keeps today's mic/audio-panel/status/level DOM exactly where it already is, no reordering risk

decision.question: Chat column — build a second widget, or a placeholder?
options: mount a second chat() call so the chat thread shows beside the diagram
a labelled placeholder column, no second chat
decision.chose: placeholder — 'chat — see the widget above/beside this page'
decision.why: requirements.md's explicit fence: Part 2 builds the diagram around @task-mastermind-one-dictation's widget, not a second one; a future pass can read ext/Chat's thread file read-only and show it as inspect() cards here instead of a live composer

decision.question: Which core/Layout approved arrangement fits 'several columns side by side, one wider structure panel'?
options: dashboard-row (named places in one flex row)
compose a new shape: a plain auto-fit wall with the Structure column spanning 2 tracks
decision.chose: the third — none of the 30 is an unequal-width row of named panels; repeat(auto-fit, minmax(16em,1fr)) is the same mechanism as core/Layout's own tile-wall entry, with grid-column: span 2 on Structure for the 'wider panel' the owner asked for
decision.why: layout skill C5: reach for an approved layout first, say it's new when none fits, rather than inventing a one-off with no justification

decision.question: At >=1200px, do the 4 debug panels (Chunks/Corrections/Live/Side) also become always-visible, or stay tab-switched even on a wide screen?
options: stay tab-switched at every width — only Raw/Clean/Analysis/Chat/Structure become columns
become always-visible too, in their own row underneath the main 5, matching the brief's own suggestion to make 'the six EXISTING panels always-visible columns instead of tab-switched'
decision.why: with all 9 panels visible there is nothing left for the tab strip to pick between, so it hides cleanly at wide instead of leaving 5 dead tab links beside 4 live ones

log.msg: Playground.js/.css/page.js/objects.js/readme.md rewritten: Session/Chunk/Resend/Analysis/Source classes wired into the existing pipeline (settle/guess/clean_chunk unchanged in logic, just reading/writing this.current instead of scattered fields); Structure panel = inspect(session), re-rendered on settle/guess/clean_chunk; Analysis stub + Chat placeholder columns added; TABS grown from 6 to 9; full-bleed CSS grid at >=1200px, tab strip hidden there, [hidden] override un-hides all 9 panels; page.js classes: 'full pad'. Next: boot the dev server on a private port and screenshot at 1920/3440/400 plus Structure before/after Sample.

shot.note: first look at 1920: tabs stayed visible AND the 5th grid item (Structure) wrapped onto its own second row, orphaned beside the debug row instead of sitting beside Raw/Clean/Analysis/Chat

log.msg: fixed: switched .ux-dictate-pg-grid/.ux-dictate-pg-debug-row from auto-fit to explicit grid-template-columns (4 even tracks + 1 double-wide for grid, 4 even for debug-row) — auto-fit was wrapping the fixed 5-panel set unpredictably, which the layout skill's own rule (fixed count wants explicit tracks, not auto-fit) says not to use here. Re-shooting to verify.

found via a real 1920 screenshot: the tab strip stayed visible at wide width even though every panel was already shown as a column. Cause: the tabs div carries the util-layer 'flex gap' utility classes, and styles/doc/cascade.md's own rule says util always beats theme regardless of specificity -- my theme-layer display:none inside the media query could never win. Fixed per that doc's own remedy: moved just that one override into its own @layer util block (same layer as .flex, later source order, no !important).
